description: Source code for the IWDG (Independent Watchdog) firmware functions for STM32F10x microcontrollers, including register access, prescaler and reload configuration, and status checking.

methods.name: IWDG_WriteAccessCmd
methods.description: Enables or disables write access to IWDG_PR and IWDG_RLR registers.

methods.name: IWDG_ReloadCounter
methods.description: Reloads the IWDG counter with the value in the reload register.

methods.name: IWDG_GetFlagStatus
methods.description: Checks whether a specific IWDG flag is set or not.
